help.db: Bundled MariaDB and Redis are initialized from the package env on first deployment.
help.login: The initial administrator account comes from W9_LOGIN_USER and W9_LOGIN_PASSWORD on first startup; later edits do not backfill existing data.
help.url: Set SEAFILE_SERVER_PROTOCOL=https when the app is published behind an HTTPS gateway or domain, and set SEAFILE_EXTERNAL_HOSTPORT to a reachable IP:port when no domain is bound.
